profile.headline: SWE @ Genesys | Grinnell College ’24
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer building scalable, partner-facing systems and developer tools for large-scale cloud platforms. Experienced in shipping integrations, APIs, and internal products that improve reliability and user experience. Passionate about operating systems and machine learning. Hispanic in computing!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and develop full-stack telephony features for a 2M+ user cloud communications platform supporting global call management services and partner integrations.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and manage Spring Boot microservices relying on REST APIs and AWS cloud infrastructure.
Design Kafka pipelines dependent on Redis databases and DynamoDB. Achieving optimal performance through multithreaded publishing.
Monitor incidents and deploy services with SumoLogic, NewRelic, GrandCentral, Jenkins, and PagerDuty.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Continue developing and enhancing the Genesys Cloud Voice Debugging service through authentication, Ember.js UI improvements, and Unit and Integration Testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Working with the Genesys Cloud Voice team using AWS, Ember, and Spring Boot tools to generate a new debugging service.
positions.insights: Skills: Maven · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ember.js · Agile Methodologies · Bitbucket · Jira

positions.title: Service Leadership Work Study (SLWS)
positions.locationName: Des Moines, Iowa, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Engaging members of the Des Moines community to be part of the initiative Plant.Grow.Fly through social media marketing, blog posting, and event management at the zoo.

positions.title: Information Technology Service Desk
positions.description:
Managing IT and software related incidents through a ticket system. 
Providing support to students, faculty, and staff members of Grinnell College with technology-related issues.

positions.title: Student Government Association's (SGA) All-Campus Events Chair
positions.description: Directing the Student Activity Fee to organize, program, and create all-campus events for the Grinnell College student body. Communicating effectively with more than 60 student organizations and their members to execute student initiatives with appropriate training, funding, security, and diversity.

positions.title: Computer Science College Tutor
positions.description: Offering support to students with their laboratory work, homework, and projects assigned in Grinnell's Computer Science courses. Solving syntax questions, helping with debugging, and improving the efficiency of a program (Scheme, C, Java).

positions.title: Student Government Association's (SGA) Technical Advisor
positions.description:
Maintaining the official Student Government webpage, servers, and applications. Ensuring an efficient user experience by brainstorming and designing the layout of the webpage and its functionality.
Executing front and back-end development, UX/UI design (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java).
Facilitating the communication between the 1,655 students on campus with the Information Technology Services.

positions.title: Photographer
positions.description: Photojournalism focused on new stories published in the student-run newspaper The Scarlet and Black.

positions.title: Administrative Manager
positions.description: Handling payment plans with suppliers and organizing tax declaration forms, supervising SCRUM operations and teams, ensuring time efficiency and synergy, planning and scheduling company events, meetings, and training.

projects.title: Image Manipulation with Kernels
projects.description: C-based coding project for the course Imperative Problem Solving and Data Structures. The program will return an uploaded image through command-line arguments with five different visual modifications and save the resulting images. The filters applied will be: blurring, spot_detection, emboss, sharpen, and edge_detect. These image modifications result from applying various kernel arrays through all the pixels in the image and assigning a calculated brightness intensity to them.
